codeReview.summary: Core picker/storage flow is mostly present, but the implementation has multiple blocking defects: the process endpoint cannot reliably read JSON bodies, geolocation matching can crash for post-activity timestamps within buffer, and required width/height metadata is not persisted.

issues.description: `/api/photos/process-session` destructures `req.body` directly (`const { sessionId, tripId } = req.body`), but neither `functions/src/index.ts` nor `functions/src/dev-server.ts` registers `express.json()`. In local/dev-server execution this leaves `req.body` undefined, causing a runtime TypeError before validation and breaking photo processing.

Nearest-index calculation can select `low === absoluteTimes.length` for timestamps slightly after the last stream point but still within the 10-minute buffer. The subsequent destructure (`streams.latlng[index]`) can read out of bounds and throw, causing per-photo processing failures instead of returning the last coordinate or null.

Persisted photo metadata omits `width` and `height`, which are explicitly required by the feature description step (6). Current metadata includes `filename`, `storagePath`, `downloadUrl`, `createdAt`, `lat`, `lng`, `mimeType`, `syncedAt` only.
Uses `alert(...)` for error handling, violating mission AGENTS.md convention to avoid blocking browser dialogs in favor of inline UI feedback.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `fullstack-worker` procedure requires lint + full test execution and interactive checks, but this feature handoff reports only targeted tests/typecheck-build and zero interactive checks while still marking `followedProcedure: true`. Skill/feedback expectations are not aligned with what is practically executed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared service command catalog lacks backend-specific test/lint commands, which encourages partial validation for function-heavy features.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Library schema guidance for trip photos omits `width`/`height`, which likely contributed to missing these required fields in implementation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/library/architecture.md` Firestore schema for `trips/{tripId}/photos/{photoId}` lists `storagePath, filename, createdAt, lat, lng, downloadUrl` but feature description requires width/height persistence.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, skill doc, and commit c41cf28. The feature is close but does not meet acceptance due to blocking backend/runtime defects and missing required metadata fields; report marked fail with concrete file/line issues and shared-state observations.
